raw_constraint_text:
## Constraints

- $1 \leq N \leq 40$
- $0 \leq M \leq \frac{N(N-1)}{2}$
- $0 \leq u_i, v_i < N$
- $u_i \neq v_i$
- $(u_i, v_i) \neq (u_j, v_j)$
